card.name: The word once or one before frequency
card.fires_on: The word "once" right after a dose in mg ("5 mg once daily"), and "one" or a following noun in "only one" or "by one" phrases, where a singular count is stressed.

modes.label: Once daily dosing
modes.description: "once" directly after a milligram dose, before "daily".
modes.example: initiate glipizide extended-release tablets at 5 mg<< once>> daily.

modes.label: Single-count phrases
modes.description: "one" or the noun after it, stressing a single item.
modes.example: Reports continued that most prisoners received only one<< meal>> per day.

card.writes: It favors words like "suffice", "single" and "only" that signal one is enough.
card.plain: It marks the spot where text says something happens just once or involves just one.
